body:
## Goal
Give operators a command-line tool over the shared store to see platform totals and to deactivate an account, run from the repo as `npm run admin -- <command>`.

## Spec
A CLI entry wired to `npm run admin -- <command>` that reads/writes ONLY through the Unit 1 store module.
- `npm run admin -- stats` prints exactly one JSON object {"users":N,"projects":N,"tasks":N} counting rows currently in the store (and nothing else on stdout).
- `npm run admin -- deactivate-user <username>` flips the named account's active flag so it can no longer log in via the API; report a clear message/nonzero exit when the username does not exist. Deactivation persists in the store and takes effect for subsequent logins. Unknown commands print usage and exit nonzero without a stack-trace crash.

## Changes
- `src/admin/cli.js` — creates
- `package.json` — refactors-existing

## Acceptance
- [ ] AC-1: `npm run admin -- stats` prints a single JSON object {users,projects,tasks} whose counts reflect the current store contents.
- [ ] AC-2: `npm run admin -- deactivate-user <username>` deactivates that account in the store, after which that user can no longer log in via the API.
- [ ] AC-3: Deactivating a non-existent user and unknown commands fail gracefully (clear message, nonzero exit) without an uncaught crash.

## Verify
- node --test test/admin/stats.test.js (unit)
- node --test test/admin/deactivate.test.js (unit)
- node --test test/e2e/deactivate-login.test.js (e2e)

## Non-Goals
- Defining user schema — that lives in Unit 1
- HTTP login enforcement — Unit 2 already rejects deactivated users; this Story only sets the flag
